_: FO4 voice type -> ElevenLabs. 'chosen' is the intimate voice used for pair barks and for a lone observer; 'chosen_loud' is the projecting voice used for crowd observer lines, because a heckle across a settlement is not a half-whisper. Both were picked by ear by the owner: preview 3 for intimate, preview 2 for loud.
audition_script: Come on - we gotta make this quick. Someone's gonna come through here any second. No, don't think about it. Just come here. Nobody needs us for a while. Stay. Just for a while.
